messages:
carmen: Anyone up for a sunrise paddle + bakery run Saturday? I can bring the thermos.
adesh: Ooh count me in if tide's good. ETA on pancake pickup?
liam: I'm torn between that or hosting a tiny backyard BBQ — I've got a spare grill and a patio firepit.
carmen: Backyard BBQ sounds great too. Could we do paddle early and BBQ later? :sunglasses: 
nina: I'm leaning movie binge + ramen at my place, sorry can't do early morning.
carmen: @nina weekend flexibility works — maybe Saturday morning paddle, evening movie? quick poll: 
adesh: paddle -> yes
liam: both -> y
nina: movie -> y
sasha: I'll bring a vegetarian option for the grill.
carmen: sweet. also heads-up: if anyone wants to WFH Monday I can host a tiny remote co-work with coffee and leftovers :thumbsup: 
liam: RSVP: paddle+bbq. Can offer carpool for 2 from Redwood office, leaves 7:15.
nina: dropping ramen and joining for movie; no carpool needed.
carmen: cool. let's meet at Pier 9 kayak rack, 6:30am? low-key, bring layers.
adesh: bringing spare life jacket. thanks!
deploy-bot: Reminder: office rooftop is booked for company event Sunday 4-6pm. :spiral_calendar:
nina: thanks @deploy-bot — that'll conflict with my movie night timing. maybe earlier.
liam: bonus: I found this terrible but funny weekend meme https://imgur.com/xyz123 :joy:
carmen: love it :rofl:
adesh: i'll start a Doodle for times, or we can just go with 6:30 paddle + 4pm bbq.
nina: sounds good. See y'all!
